changelog: Hardware v2 support: PN532 NFC reader over I2C with a native driver (auto-detected, ACR122U still supported), with reliable reads through the case and no more stuttering video from tags at the edge of range. New status LED on GPIO13 with hardware PWM: lit at power-on, fast breathing while booting, slow breathing when idle or paused, steady while playing or when viewing is blocked by time limits. Faster boot (cloud-init disabled after first boot). setup.sh fixes: apt no longer fails with /boot/firmware read-only.
